article.headline: Lemond’s 15 lead Binghamton past Misericordia 87-62
article.description: — Jayden Lemond’s 15 points helped Binghamton defeat Misericordia 87-62 on Wednesday.
article.story: DALLAS -- — Jayden Lemond’s 15 points helped Binghamton defeat Misericordia 87-62 on Wednesday. Lemond shot 5 of 7 from the field and 5 for 9 from the line for the Bearcats (3-1). Kofi Peyton scored 14 points while going 5 of 8 (2 for 5 from 3-point range). Jeremiah Quigley had 14 points and shot 6 for 15, including 2 for 3 from beyond the arc. Eli Stoute finished with 16 points for Misericordia. Jack Gallagher added 10 points. Up next Binghamton visits Duquesne in its next matchup on Saturday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
